contexts.text: Man has overthrown and destroyed order.
The external of the thought and will become vitiated and destroyed.
All the Heavens would be so severely shaken that the Angels could not subsist.
From the privation of this love, that whole form would be ruined.
Fear lest the domestic affairs should be destroyed.
At last the internal man is destroyed.
His honour, name, and reputation... are destroyed.
a. As the affection of their life and its delight began thus to be destroyed...
Then the Lord directs His love... to restore the state which labours and begins to be destroyed.
As thereby the ultimate Heaven... began to be shaken...
That Heaven was shaken by conjunction with the Hells in its ultimates, may be illustrated by the extreme weakening of a man, from which at last he dies.
God. 7. 13. In proportion as ends opposite to love do not obstruct and destroy...
God. 7. 14. Provides lest ends from opposite loves... do not ruin the work of creation even to utter destruction.
